prompt:
Research what the Home Assistant project has officially published about the number of active installations (its opt-in analytics). Cite the page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Home Assistant publishes installation statistics through its opt-in analytics program, which aggregates data from users who voluntarily choose to share their usage information. Because participation is optional and not enabled by default, the project explicitly states that these figures represent only a portion of the total user base, though they are used to guide development priorities and advocate for local control with manufacturers.

Recent data indicates significant growth in the ecosystem. In April 2025, the project announced that it had surpassed 2 million active installations, doubling its user base from the previous year. However, the live analytics dashboard currently displays a lower figure (approximately 695,000), which reflects only those users who have actively opted in to share data at this time. Historical context from the project notes that typically less than a fourth of all users opt in, suggesting the actual total number of installations is significantly higher than the raw analytics count.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/04/16/state-of-the-open-home-recap/ | QUOTE: "One big announcement Franck made was that this year we went from 1 million to over 2 million active installations in 2024!" | CLAIM: The Home Assistant project officially announced that it reached over 2 million active installations in 2024.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "695,026 Active Home Assistant Installations" | CLAIM: The live Home Assistant Analytics dashboard currently reports 695,026 active installations that have opted in to share data.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "We estimate that less than a fourth of all Home Assistant users opt in." | CLAIM: The project estimates that the opt-in analytics data represents fewer than 25% of the total user base.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/analytics | QUOTE: "Sharing analytics is completely optional." | CLAIM: Participation in the analytics program is not mandatory for users.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/11/12/100k-analytics/ | QUOTE: "Our estimate is that there are 4-5x more installations than people that opt-in to analytics." | CLAIM: The project has historically estimated the total number of installations to be four to five times the number of opt-in analytics participants.
